text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system treats past purchases and listening or viewing choices as continuing interest in broadly related items, with insufficient attention to current purpose.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they preserve a specific musical or story preference rather than merely matching a broad category.",
    "Practical recommendations succeed when they complement demonstrated activities or add a useful capability to existing equipment."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related products and media compete with stronger matches to the user's recent task, preferred sound, story, or mood.",
    "Recent ownership is treated as continuing demand for similar products, even when the purchase has already satisfied that need.",
    "Specialized accessories and supplies are recommended without sufficient evidence of compatible equipment, dimensions, or an active project."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared category, ecosystem, era, or collection label appears to substitute for a specific reason to choose the item.",
    "Isolated or older interactions are extended into persistent preferences across unrelated tasks, genres, and seasonal contexts."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent coherent activity often provides a stronger guide to current intent than older or isolated interactions.",
    "Functional compatibility and useful additions matter more than general proximity to previously purchased equipment.",
    "Fine distinctions in mood, musical style, narrative interest, and performance format determine choice among otherwise relevant items."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items often establish broad relevance without establishing a specific current benefit, allowing redundant, incompatible, or contextually weak choices to displace compelling matches.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, separated from items they consider relevant but would defer.",
    "The frequency of rejection for duplicated functionality, unsupported compatibility, or an unestablished project need.",
    "The rate at which recent-intent matches rank above items supported only by older activity or broad similarity.",
    "The frequency of indeterminate judgments due to insufficient item information, kept separate from explicit preference mismatches."
  ]
}
